post.title: This frog freezes solid… and survives 🐸❄️
post.description:
Send this to someone who needs a reminder that winter ends.

The wood frog lets up to about two-thirds of its body water freeze. Its heart stops, and glucose from its liver protects its cells until spring.
post.pinned_comment: Would you rather freeze like this frog or hibernate like a bear? 👇

scenes.narration: THIS FROG CAN FREEZE SOLID… AND STILL SURVIVE.

subs: When winter arrives, most animals escape the cold.
But this frog has a different strategy.
scenes.narration: When winter arrives, most animals escape the cold. But this frog has a different strategy.

subs: Its liver releases huge amounts of glucose.
A natural antifreeze that protects its vital cells.
scenes.narration: Its liver releases huge amounts of glucose. A natural antifreeze that protects its vital cells.

subs: Up to two-thirds of its body water can freeze.
scenes.narration: Its heart stops. It stops breathing. Up to two-thirds of its body water can freeze.
For weeks… it waits. Not dead. Just waiting for spring.

subs: As temperatures rise, its body thaws.
scenes.narration: As temperatures rise, its body thaws. And life begins again.

subs: Nature doesn't always escape the impossible.
scenes.narration: Nature doesn't always escape the impossible. Sometimes… it survives it.
